shared_elements: frontal standing human figure with arms raised/extended
hand shown with splayed separate fingers
small subsidiary figures or signs scattered around a larger central figure
figures carved/marked directly on a natural rock surface
justification: Both surfaces present a dominant frontal anthropomorph with raised/outstretched arms and splayed fingers, accompanied by smaller subsidiary figures and by ring and spiral motifs distributed around it on an irregular rock face, which is a moderately specific shared scheme. The manner of depiction differs strongly, however: A renders bodies and discs as bulging, rounded three-dimensional masses with modelled limbs, while B uses flat, thin, silhouette-like schematic figures with stick-thin limbs and linear animal and boat-like signs, and B includes clear quadrupeds absent from A.
